additional_context: FHIR-22666 is the same change family: it narrowed the source and target scope parameter documentation and explicitly called for a related tracker to preserve removed text elsewhere. ConceptMap is active in source/fhir.ini and its operation list references OperationDefinition/ConceptMap-translate. reconciliation: No source files were changed. The active operation description already says the source value set is optional because clients may not know it, but SHOULD be provided because a server may otherwise be unable to safely identify an applicable concept map.
